{{Quote|Questioning by Alliance expeditors traced her surgery and training back to the asteroid compound.|[[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] report|<ref name="HNN48">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|48|business/13321_1.html|Corporate Alliance Attacks Slicer Compound}}</ref>}}
An '''expeditor''' referred to an occupational role in which individuals facilitated a process through measures including business investigation. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]] expeditors helped uncover an illegitimate [[Slicer/Legends|slicing]] operation taking place on the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Yirt-4138-Grek-12]]. Expeditors also established connections between [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] or [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] officials.
